name: Mara Vale
core_function: Playable protagonist who turns practical attention into self-authored choices
player_hook: Notice what others overlook and decide what it means
visual_motif: Braid; worn denim; notebook; grease-stained hands
design_guardrail: Competence comes from access and practice; never frame knowledge gaps as low intelligence

name: Abel Vale
core_function: Father and master mechanic whose love skill certainty and control can coexist
player_hook: Learn from him while deciding when obedience becomes unsafe
visual_motif: Red work cap; square glasses; loader; weathered hands
design_guardrail: Keep humor courage skill love and self-deception together; no cartoon zealot

name: Ruth Vale
core_function: Healer and entrepreneur whose crisis competence contrasts with domestic appeasement
player_hook: Help care for people while choosing what evidence and outside help matter
visual_motif: Amber bottles; herbs; scale; green corded phone
design_guardrail: Show real care and skill alongside unsupported claims and denial

name: Jonah Vale
core_function: Older brother who models study order music and quiet departure
player_hook: Ask for help without surrendering the problem
visual_motif: Pencil notes; cassette; clean tools; algebra
design_guardrail: His stutter is situational and never comic shorthand

name: Silas Vale
core_function: Charismatic older brother whose skill and affection can turn possessive or threatening
player_hook: Read whether closeness is becoming control
visual_motif: Rope; climbing gloves; half-smile; truck mirror
design_guardrail: Boundaries matter more than affection; never reward endurance of abuse

name: Eliza Vale
core_function: Older sister who notices contradictions but must weigh recognition against belonging
player_hook: Compare what she knows with what she is willing to say
visual_motif: Ledger; folded dish towel; watchful eyes
design_guardrail: Recognition and action can diverge without making her simple coward or hero

name: Nora Vale
core_function: Grandmother and town countervoice who offers practical alternatives and blunt pressure
player_hook: Gain access to roads town and outside routines without treating escape as simple
visual_motif: Station wagon; seatbelt; grocery sacks; map
design_guardrail: Her help can be loving impatient or controlling; avoid idealized outsider wisdom

name: Caleb Hart
core_function: Town friend and radio hobbyist who makes ordinary care feel unfamiliar
player_hook: Test trust through everyday companionship rather than rescue
visual_motif: CB radio; first-aid kit; work jacket; car keys
design_guardrail: He is not a savior; his power is ordinary social ease and respect

name: Dr. Miriam Kline
core_function: Historian and mentor who teaches source comparison and revision
player_hook: Bring incomplete evidence and learn better questions
visual_motif: Archive box; index cards; desk lamp; chalkboard
design_guardrail: Mentorship deepens through work and evidence not praise

name: Rev. Isaac Hale
core_function: Pastor who represents stewardship faith as a counterpoint to fear-based certainty
player_hook: See how belief can produce care humility service and disagreement
visual_motif: Meetinghouse light; casserole dish; hymnal; work gloves
design_guardrail: Faith must stay plural social and human; never use religion as morality meter

name: Deputy Lena Ortiz
core_function: County responder who embodies procedure public duty and institutional limits
player_hook: Call for help and discover what formal systems can and cannot do
visual_motif: Radio; clipboard; reflective jacket; county vehicle
design_guardrail: Do not portray institutions as automatically wise safe or malicious

name: Tess Ward
core_function: Peer rival performer and salvager who competes as an equal
player_hook: Win respect through skill choices humor or refusal to compete
visual_motif: Theater light; wrench; boots; ticket stub
design_guardrail: Rivalry can become respect distance or exploitation; no mean-girl simplification

name: Wade Mercer
core_function: Quarry contractor who turns deadlines and money into systemic pressure
player_hook: Recognize when incentives make unsafe choices feel normal
visual_motif: Hard hat; contract folder; quarry lights; diesel dust
design_guardrail: He is not the source of every family problem and should have plausible incentives

name: Vale Homestead
core_function: Home consequence hub where routines relationships and retellings change nightly
player_hook: Return to a familiar place that is never emotionally identical
visual_motif: Red railcar; barn; red-oak table; mountain silhouette
design_guardrail: Home must contain warmth humor work and conflict; not a misery set

name: Iron Hollow Salvage
core_function: Primary work playground for repair salvage machinery economy and danger
player_hook: Turn junk into capability while reading hazards and authority
visual_motif: Oxidized steel; loader; chain; sorted metal
design_guardrail: Competence should be beautiful and danger spatially readable

name: Mercy House
core_function: Healing workshop and family business where care belief evidence and reputation collide
player_hook: Prepare remedies document symptoms call outside help or negotiate privacy
visual_motif: Amber jars; herbs; birch cabinets; green phone
design_guardrail: Do not present herbal knowledge as either magic or stupidity

name: Cedar Gate Main Street
core_function: Small-town social hub where family reputation arrives before Mara does
player_hook: Learn the town by sight and by who greets avoids or watches you
visual_motif: One stoplight; brick storefronts; pickup trucks; church steeple
design_guardrail: Town residents must vary in class belief knowledge kindness and prejudice

name: Merritt's Fuel & Post
core_function: Fuel counter post office and gossip interchange based on memoir village texture
player_hook: Pick up supplies and hear what the county thinks happened
visual_motif: Gas pumps; mailboxes; coffee pot; bulletin board
design_guardrail: Background talk should create pressure or opportunity not exposition dumps

name: Cedar Gate Opera House
core_function: Performance space where Mara practices voice social timing and alternate identity
player_hook: Rehearse perform improvise and meet people who know a different Mara
visual_motif: Backstage rope; footlights; costumes; old marquee
design_guardrail: Performance should be active gameplay not a montage reward

name: Cedar Gate Carnegie Library
core_function: Early self-directed learning hub with basement children’s-room texture
player_hook: Search ask browse copy notes or discover what words mean
visual_motif: Card catalog; basement stairs; photocopier; paper map
design_guardrail: Research should require choices about sources and time not trivia quizzes

name: Meetinghouse and Community Hall
core_function: Faith and service space where public address differs from private relationships
player_hook: Attend help question sing serve or leave early
visual_motif: Hymnal; folding chairs; kitchen; coat rack
design_guardrail: Represent multiple faith postures and community functions in the same room

name: South Fork
core_function: Backcountry region for horses herbs cabins river routes and quiet conversations
player_hook: Choose route weather preparation and companions
visual_motif: River stones; horse tack; herbs; quarry road
design_guardrail: Landscape is not filler; traversal must create information and risk

name: Highline Pass
core_function: Weather-exposed ridge with radio tower snow switchbacks and restricted routes
player_hook: Investigate signals manage exposure and decide when to turn back
visual_motif: Radio mast; snow stakes; switchback road; storm cloud
design_guardrail: Curiosity must have preparation costs but retreat must remain valid

name: Echo Quarry
core_function: Economic pressure zone where contracts safety and family reputation intersect
player_hook: Work for money inspect shortcuts document hazards or refuse a task
visual_motif: Quarry wall; sodium lights; contracts; heavy equipment
design_guardrail: No faceless evil corporation; pressure comes through incentives people and deadlines

name: Briar College South Apartments
core_function: Culture-shock home base where unwritten rules become visible
player_hook: Learn roommate norms transit hygiene schedules and belonging
visual_motif: Shared sink; city noise; paper schedule; bus map
design_guardrail: Do not turn missing cultural knowledge into humiliation comedy

name: Briar College Academic Core
core_function: Cluster of auditorium computer lab engineering hall registrar and faculty offices
player_hook: Move from confusion to self-directed use of institutions
visual_motif: CRT monitors; lecture hall; janitor cart; blue book
design_guardrail: Institutional navigation should reward asking comparing and returning

name: Old Court Cambridge
core_function: Historical academic environment where beauty and belonging can coexist with insecurity
player_hook: Explore gates courts cloisters libraries and mentor spaces
visual_motif: Stone gate; porter lodge; cloister; small window
design_guardrail: Historical awe should not erase class or cultural disorientation

name: East Coast Fellowship
core_function: Harvard-Boston region for research urban navigation and family collision
player_hook: Use transit libraries seminars and parent visits to test the new self
visual_motif: Brick yard; grand library; subway gate; small dorm room
design_guardrail: A wider world is not automatically kinder or more truthful

name: Attention
core_function: Turns looking listening touching and comparison into actionable information
player_hook: Notice a crack a changed word a weather shift or a hesitation
visual_motif: Focus shift; hand-to-object contact; margin note
design_guardrail: Do not highlight every important object; let context and skill matter

name: Repair and Salvage
core_function: Hands-on work system for diagnosing tools parts sequence risk and improvisation
player_hook: Solve the same job safely quickly cheaply collaboratively or not at all
visual_motif: Wrench; chalk mark; service manual; sparks
design_guardrail: Failure changes conditions instead of producing repetitive reloads

name: Care and Treatment
core_function: Decision system for symptoms first aid remedies privacy transport and escalation
player_hook: Choose what to do when care is urgent and certainty is incomplete
visual_motif: Vitals note; herb bottle; phone; car keys
design_guardrail: No medical misinformation as reward; uncertainty must stay legible

name: Traversal and Weather
core_function: Movement system where route surface visibility vehicle condition and weather change options
player_hook: Travel by foot horse truck bus or borrowed ride while reading the world
visual_motif: Tire tracks; map fold; snow; river crossing
design_guardrail: Travel is never dead time or only scenery

name: Conversation Intent
core_function: Dialogue system based on intention timing and relationship context rather than correct lines
player_hook: Ask challenge joke deflect agree remain silent leave or return later
visual_motif: Eye contact; pause; work-in-progress; doorway
design_guardrail: No magic dialogue answer that fixes another person

name: Relationship State
core_function: Tracks trust respect dependence fear loyalty and clarity independently
player_hook: Gain access in one dimension while losing another
visual_motif: Open door; borrowed tool; withheld look; shared task
design_guardrail: Never collapse relationships into affection points

name: Worldview Profile
core_function: Models what characters value notice fear praise and interpret
player_hook: Understand another worldview without having to adopt it
visual_motif: Scripture margin; checklist; archive note; radio news
design_guardrail: Do not score private belief as good or bad

name: Evidence and Memory
core_function: Separates Saw Heard and Concluded while preserving revised interpretations
player_hook: Build a case that can remain uncertain and change later
visual_motif: Notebook columns; receipt; chalk photo; conflicting testimony
design_guardrail: The game must sometimes allow several defensible interpretations

name: Home Consequence Hub
core_function: Converts outside actions into changed routines access mood gossip and retellings
player_hook: Return home to discover what your choice became in other people’s stories
visual_motif: Table setting; empty chair; changed chore list; phone message
design_guardrail: Consequences should emerge through behavior not a results screen

name: Capability and Time
core_function: Grows practical and intellectual capability while time money favors parts fatigue and access constrain plans
player_hook: Choose what to learn do postpone or ask someone else to do
visual_motif: Watch; toolbox; bus schedule; cash envelope
design_guardrail: No generic XP morality or loot rarity treadmill

name: The Hairline Crack
core_function: Repair encounter that tests safety authority competence and evidence
player_hook: Inspect reinforce challenge delay ask for help or proceed
visual_motif: Cracked axle; chalk line; Abel waiting
design_guardrail: Every approach must change both practical and relational state

name: Suspended Load
core_function: Dynamic work hazard that turns spatial reading into an immediate choice
player_hook: Cut power stabilize warn pull someone clear or call help
visual_motif: Swinging chain; kill switch; shadow; mud
design_guardrail: Readable danger first; spectacle second

name: Treatment or Clinic
core_function: Care conflict where treatment escalation and family loyalty collide
player_hook: Prepare remedy call clinic ask the patient document or split tasks
visual_motif: Herb table; green phone; county car outside
design_guardrail: No false certainty about medical outcomes

name: County Road Confidant
core_function: Travel conversation where ordinary outside concern challenges normalized danger
player_hook: Defend family joke change subject ask a question or disclose one detail
visual_motif: Dashboard; seatbelt; creek bridge; radio
design_guardrail: The friend cannot solve the family system

name: Town Reputation
core_function: Social encounter where a stranger or peer already knows a version of Mara’s family
player_hook: Hide defend question joke trade information or walk away
visual_motif: Store counter; glance; newspaper clipping; receipt
design_guardrail: Reputation should create openings as well as stigma

name: Ridge Signal
core_function: Exploration mystery where curiosity competes with weather preparation and permission
player_hook: Investigate mark the location ask Caleb prepare better or retreat
visual_motif: Radio burst; smoke thread; storm front; trail marker
design_guardrail: Mystery must expand the game beyond college without becoming conspiracy fantasy

name: Supper Version
core_function: Home scene where the day is retold and one fact shifts
player_hook: Correct one detail tell the full version support someone remain silent or leave
visual_motif: Red-oak table; serving bowl; changed wording
design_guardrail: Silence is a real action with later consequences

name: Rules Nobody Explained
core_function: College encounter where assumed knowledge creates friction and choice
player_hook: Ask for directions read a posted rule follow others improvise or arrive late
visual_motif: Bus map; registrar desk; course sheet; CRT terminal
design_guardrail: Knowledge gaps come from access not intelligence

name: Covenant Protection
core_function: Safety through obedience separation preparation and family unity
player_hook: Explains why risk and loyalty can feel morally linked
visual_motif: Stored food; weather radio; family prayer
design_guardrail: Must include love courage and genuine protective intent alongside control

name: Stewardship Faith
core_function: Faith expressed through care humility service repair and responsibility
player_hook: Offers a religious counterpoint without demanding disbelief
visual_motif: Work gloves; casserole dish; hymnal; repaired fence
design_guardrail: Do not make this the author-approved perfect faith

name: Civic Trust
core_function: Shared evidence procedure and public institutions can protect where private systems fail
player_hook: Makes records clinic rescue school and law meaningful options
visual_motif: Clipboard; clinic sign; public map; county radio
design_guardrail: Institutions retain limits bias cost and bureaucracy

name: Skeptical Pragmatism
core_function: Test claims against observable results and remain wary of unverifiable certainty
player_hook: Rewards experiments practical comparison and provisional belief
visual_motif: Multimeter; checklist; repeated test; spare part
design_guardrail: Pragmatism can miss meaning history and relationships

name: Scholarly Inquiry
core_function: Compare sources name uncertainty revise conclusions and seek historical context
player_hook: Turns education into new verbs rather than a destination
visual_motif: Archive box; footnote; lecture slide; index card
design_guardrail: Scholarship does not guarantee wisdom kindness or courage

name: Trust
core_function: Willingness to rely on another person’s word presence or discretion
player_hook: Changes what people tell Mara and what they ask her to hold
visual_motif: Shared key; private note; unguarded silence
design_guardrail: Trust can coexist with fear disagreement and dependence

name: Respect
core_function: Recognition of competence judgment or boundaries
player_hook: Changes who accepts Mara’s decision even without agreement
visual_motif: Handed-over tool; paused argument; direct eye contact
design_guardrail: Respect is not the same as affection or obedience

name: Dependence
core_function: Practical or emotional need that binds people even when the relationship hurts
player_hook: Changes access leverage obligation and fear of loss
visual_motif: Borrowed vehicle; medicine batch; paycheck; ride home
design_guardrail: Dependence must not be mislabeled as love

name: Fear
core_function: Expectation that honesty refusal distance or failure may bring harm or exclusion
player_hook: Changes timing silence route choice and who is present at conversations
visual_motif: Doorway; lowered voice; checked rearview mirror
design_guardrail: Fear is information not a cowardice score

name: Loyalty
core_function: Commitment to protect identify with or stand beside a person group or story
player_hook: Changes what Mara is willing to defend conceal or risk
visual_motif: Family photo; shared work shirt; public introduction
design_guardrail: Loyalty can be generous costly conflicted and revisable

name: Clarity
core_function: How well Mara understands another person’s patterns motives limits and likely responses
player_hook: Unlocks better predictions and boundary options rather than manipulation
visual_motif: Repeated phrase; remembered gesture; linked journal notes
design_guardrail: Understanding never guarantees control or reconciliation
